metadata.scenario: A business calls seeking a quote for monthly commercial cleaning services. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi, Margaret, this is Mary O'Connor. I’m calling to get a quote for monthly commercial cleaning services. Oh, I'm sorry, Mary, but we primarily provide home healthcare services. Yes, I understand that, but I thought you might have a referral or something. I see. Let me check if I can help you with that. Can you tell me a bit about your needs for the cleaning services? Sure, it’s a small office space, about 1,500 square feet. We need weekly cleaning, including carpets, bathrooms, and kitchen areas. Got it. And do you have any specific cleaning requirements or products you prefer? We prefer eco-friendly products, and we also need a deep clean every month. That makes sense. Let me write this down. Are you looking for any additional services, like window cleaning or floor maintenance? Yes, actually, window cleaning would be great. We have a lot of natural light in the office. Perfect! And just to confirm, you need a quote for the weekly cleaning and monthly deep clean, plus window cleaning. Yes, that’s correct. I’ll need to get back to you with a quote after I check with our cleaning service partner. Can I take your email address for that? Sure, it’s mary.oconnor@email.com. Thank you! I’ll follow up with you by the end of the week. I appreciate it, Margaret. Also, do you have any recommendations for home health services? Absolutely! We offer services like IV therapy and skilled nursing. Would you like me to send you more details? Yes, that would be helpful! Great! I’ll include that in my follow-up email. Thank you so much, Margaret! You're welcome, Mary! Have a great day! You too! Goodbye! Goodbye!
